name: Anhui Huaertai Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Huaertai Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization of a diverse array of chemical substances. Their extensive catalog includes essential industrial chemicals such as ammonium sulfate, hydrogen peroxide, 65 niacin, sulfur trioxide, and melamine. Additionally, the company supplies concentrated sulfuric and nitric acids, oleum, industrial-grade sodium nitrite and nitrate, liquid ammonia, ammonium bicarbonate, and methanol. This enterprise, founded in 2000, has its operational base located in Chizhou, China.
